x: Ches Walker ran a good race to win the 880 yards in the fast time of 2 mins. 2 secs., while Jack Brown won the 1 mile race in 4 mins. 32.3 secs. D.

Held at the “ News of the World ” track at Mitcham on June 14th this match was styled a “ B ” team affair. We did not score any points in the 100 yards but in the 220, which was held in two sections, we had two first places with D.
